teaching.title: Introductory Programming Assistance
bullets: Assisted introductory programming lab sessions on lists, dictionaries, and debugging, and answered student questions during office hours.
Graded programming exercises using an instructor-provided rubric as part of assigned teaching assistant responsibilities.

projects.title: Text-File Analyser
bullets: Implemented a small command-line text-file analyser using Python functions and collections for an individual undergraduate course project.
Used Git for the project, tested example inputs, and documented the program's behaviour.
